methodology: 20 concurrent isolated domain/repository instances per case; each cold then same-instance warm reopen. Delay at each mock GitHub JSON Response: RTT + encoded JSON bytes / bandwidth. No shared-link contention or production/geography inference. Legacy page/search operate on already returned client manifests; candidate pages/search incur a fresh HEAD check. Gateway→browser RTT not injected here. Resource/RSS claims excluded from this concurrent model.

collection.resourceAggregation: endpoint class counts/body bytes/transfer bytes/sum durations per original phase; individual phase timings and repository counters preserved. Resource duration sums overlap, not wall-clock.
